sam: Quick Q — if a client sets `model_routing_hint: \"gpt-neox-20b:quant8\"` and that exact variant isn't available in eu-west, what does the API contract say we do? fallback to base id, route to another region, or error? cc @maria

maria: Short answer: we try best-effort fallbacks but we make the decision visible in the response. Order of checks: exact match -> same-family without variant suffix -> compatible family -> region fallback (if allow_cross_region) -> capacity error. We always include a `served_model` and `routing_reason` in the response so clients know what actually served them.

josh: To add detail: if client sets `allow_cross_region=false` and no compatible models in requested region, we return 503 with error_code `no_capacity`. If `allow_cross_region=true` we route to nearest permitted region and set `routing_reason` e.g. `cross_region_fallback`. We do NOT silently degrade model architecture (i.e., don't map neox -> llama) unless it is explicitly allowed in the routing policy.

lee: Also important: runtime verifies model-tokenizer/runtime compatibility. If we strip suffix (quant -> base) we run compatibility checks for tokenizer/vocab and kv-cache shape. If incompatible, skip that fallback path. We consult the model compatibility matrix (kept in model-registry) during routing.

sam: Can we show a minimal request/response example so SDK folks know what to expect?

maria: Example (request + response):

```
# request
{ "model_routing_hint": "gpt-neox-20b:quant8", "region": "eu-west", "allow_cross_region": false }

# response
{ "status": "ok", "served_model": "gpt-neox-20b", "routing_reason": "variant_unavailable -> stripped_suffix", "region": "eu-west" }
```

Note: if nothing can serve, response will be `status: error` with `error_code: no_capacity` (503). We intentionally avoid returning 200 + null served_model for capacity errors to make retries clearer.

josh: One more contract detail: legacy param `model_hint` is still accepted but we return `deprecation_warning` header and map it to `model_routing_hint`. Please add an integration test for that mapping.

deploy-bot: FYI: rolling the routing-policy change to prod tonight at 23:00 UTC. Canary on eu-west first.

maria: I'll add a short spec doc in the API repo and a unit test in eng-platform that covers: suffix strip, tokenizer mismatch path, cross-region toggle, and deprecation mapping. @josh can you add the served_model + routing_reason presence lint?

sam: sgtm, thanks all :thumbsup:
